fact: On 4 December 2024 the customs directorate and Korea Customs Service launched a project to create the Enhanced Risk Management (ERA) system, automated risk management using artificial intelligence with scoring indexed to declarations on Sydonia World, due to be fully in place in 2026.
title: Lancement du projet de modernisation du système de dédouanement électronique à Madagascar
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
